svg.title: b89 product — Brewinator
svg.desc: Stacked Brew/inator, split on the -inator suffix. Sizes differ per line because JetBrains Mono is monospaced, so a 6-character line set at the same size as a 4-character one overruns: Brew at 80 measures 192px, inator at 58 measures 209px. Matching the sizes instead of the widths was tried first and made the lower line read as a subtitle rather than part of the name. Baselines are copied unchanged from RomForge so the two b89 icons share a vertical rhythm.
